StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:137-140) adds unconditionally, which is exactly what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch anywhere in it). StackType's only non-presentation readers are GetTypeForAmount (PowerModel.cs:462) and InvokePowerModified's VFX split (Creature.cs:628). Both are third-file citations not hashed by this record.

The gate is self-applied inside FrailPower.modify_block_multiplicative (powers.py:756) via `is_powered_card_or_monster_move_block(props)`, not centrally in BlockCmd.apply; the two C# predicates are identical (ValuePropExtensions.cs:5-21) and the sim's helper (valueprops.py:52-56) matches both. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

powers.py:759 returns 0.75. Unlike Weak's and Shrink's, this factor is hard-coded in C# too (no DynamicVar) and 3/4 is dyadic, so the sim's float product equals C#'s decimal fold -- this is one of the five binary-exact block factors hook_dispatch's block-site dormancy argument rests on. Executed: `py audit/tools/power_census.py multipliers`.

FrailPower.cs:25-31 is the third member of the Vulnerable/Weak/Frail TickDownDuration trio; the sim uses on_enemy_side_end (combat.py:792, the Hook.AfterTurnEnd(Enemy) slot) and _tick_duration (powers.py:179-), matching both.
